name: Hidden Markov Models and Dynamical Systems (book)

mentions.name: Hidden Markov Models and Dynamical Systems (book)
mentions.description: Second edition of the book "Hidden Markov Models and Dynamical Systems," which explains several state space models and connects them to ideas about chaos. A PDF draft is available online, and the book's source software can build the PDF via "make book", making it reproducible research.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm polishing up the second edition of "Hidden Markov Models and Dynamical Systems."  The book explains several state space models and connects them to ideas about chaos.  Here's a link to a pdf draft: https://www.fraserphysics.com/book.pdf and here's a link to source for the book: https://gitlab.com/fraserphysics/hmmds
